description: Unique identifier assigned to an individual patient
purpose: Patient identification and linkage of clinical records
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(c) - compliance with a legal obligation
gdpr_article_9_basis: Not independently applicable unless linked to health data
pdpl_basis: Processing necessary to satisfy applicable healthcare and regulatory obligations
safeguards: Encryption at rest and in transit
classification_reason: High-sensitivity identifiable personal data requires elevated protection.

description: Raw and processed electroencephalography measurements generated during BCI sessions
purpose: Clinical neural-signal analysis and BCI operation
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(c) - compliance with a legal obligation
gdpr_article_9_basis: Article 9(2)(h) - medical diagnosis, provision of health or social care, or management of health systems and services
pdpl_basis: Sensitive health data processing subject to applicable PDPL healthcare and sensitive-data requirements
classification_reason: Special-category health or biometric data requires enhanced privacy safeguards.

description: Network address associated with the BCI acquisition device or patient session
purpose: Security monitoring, device connectivity, and troubleshooting
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(f) - legitimate interests in maintaining system and network security
gdpr_article_9_basis: Not applicable when processed independently of special-category information
pdpl_basis: Processing for legitimate operational and security purposes, subject to applicable PDPL conditions
safeguards: IP truncation or pseudonymization where feasible
classification_reason: Identifiable or linkable personal data with moderate privacy impact.

description: Date and time associated with an individual BCI recording session
purpose: Clinical session sequencing, auditability, and troubleshooting
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(c) - compliance with healthcare recordkeeping obligations
gdpr_article_9_basis: Article 9(2)(h) when the timestamp forms part of the patient's health record
pdpl_basis: Processing necessary for healthcare record management and applicable regulatory obligations
classification_reason: Identifiable or linkable personal data with moderate privacy impact.

description: Record of patient privacy notices, permissions, withdrawals, and consent history
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(c) - compliance with legal accountability obligations
gdpr_article_9_basis: Article 9(2)(a) - explicit consent where consent is the applicable condition for special-category processing
pdpl_basis: Consent documentation and withdrawal management where consent is the applicable legal basis under PDPL
classification_reason: High-sensitivity identifiable personal data requires elevated protection.

description: Clinical observations, diagnoses, treatment context, and interpretation of neural-signal results
purpose: Diagnosis, treatment, clinical interpretation, and continuity of care
gdpr_article_6_basis: Article 6(1)(c) - compliance with healthcare and professional obligations
gdpr_article_9_basis: Article 9(2)(h) - medical diagnosis and provision of health care
pdpl_basis: Sensitive health data processing necessary for healthcare services, subject to applicable PDPL requirements
classification_reason: Special-category health or biometric data requires enhanced privacy safeguards.
